title: Vishnu Dharmam - 02 - Mantrakavacham, Mantrasiddhi and Mantrabalam
author: Vishnu Sreenivas
excerpt: The first lesson that is taught by Sri Vishnu Dharmam is how one must reduce the sins that are committed during their life. Shounaka Maharishi tells Shathaneeka that one must first commit themselves to know what their purpose and meaning in life is. If one seeks this, they can find knowledge. Through finding knowledge, they learn about the world and everything nature has to teach.
